newsitem.title: UK: Matthew Clark shares fail to shake headache.
newsitem.headline: Matthew Clark shares fail to shake headache.

text.p: Shares in UK drinks maker Matthew Clark Plc, which slumped over 30 percent on Tuesday, took another dive on Wednesday amid what dealers called a raft of downgrades after the company's surprise profits warning.
Matthew Clark was down 76p or 17.6 percent at a new year low of 355p, while the FTSE 100 index was down 9.7 percent.
The stock took a hammering on Tuesday after the company said increased competition in the branded drinks market, notably from alcopops, could affect full year results.
"The stock was rapidly shifted onto sell lists -- practically everyone was on buy yesterday," said one marketmaker.
Market sources said Kleinwort Benson had changed its recommendation on the stock to "hold" from "buy" and now estimated a 30 percent profit drop for the year.
